title: Grateful Dead Live at Copps Coliseum on 1990-03-21
source: flac16/48kHz; Master Audience Recording & Transfer by Ray Ackerman: AKG 460B/CK63 ULS> AKG B18 phantom power unit> Panasonic SV250> DAT (OTS); Transfer info: Tascam DA 30 mkii> Microtrack ii> wavelab 5> WAV 16/48

ai_review.summary: Audience tape captures the vibrant upstate NY atmosphere with a spacious soundstage, while the performance feels fresh and energetic.
ai_review.review: The reviewer notes that this solo‑taped audience recording delivers a strong sense of space when listened on headphones, despite some wear on the Panasonic deck heads. The show itself is praised as lively and passionate, matching the energy described in the venue’s unique vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 4‑star review highlights a solid performance and an engaging audience recording; limited data prevents higher confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded with a Panasonic SV250 tape deck; mic pre and converters were decent but heads wore down, leading to some tape‑deck noise. Emphasis on real‑space feel works well with headphones.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is described as a blend of laid‑back West Coast chill and NYC intensity, delivering fresh, passionate playing throughout.
